prompt: Create an original 150 second Chinese chamber instrumental instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: guzheng, xiao, soft wooden percussion. Style: pentatonic melodic arcs, plucked ornament and spacious breath. Tempo approximately 66 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A serene and traditional East Asian-inspired piece featuring a plucked string instrument, flute, and light percussion, creating a peaceful and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静而富有传统东方韵味的乐曲，以弹拨乐器、长笛和轻柔的打击乐器为主，营造出平和而沉思的氛围。
